headlines.name: Ilhan Omar
headlines.headline: Records show how DOJ, judge debated constitutional implications of searching Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
headlines.description: The unsealed filings show that U.S. Magistrate Judge Matthew Sharbaugh — before authorizing the search of Omar's home — raised concerns about the “Speech or Debate Clause” implications of searching a private residence belonging to a member of Congress.

sources.title: A federal judge unseals court documents in connection with the search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
